observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher provides clear, step-by-step instructions while explaining the cultural context of the dance. She uses simple, repetitive verbal cues and demonstrates movements from multiple angles to ensure clarity.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces the dance and its cultural origin.
The teacher explains the importance of flat-footed technique.
The teacher breaks down the forward and backward movement.
The teacher explains the hip movement and the importance of the lead foot.
The teacher adds arm movements to the basic step.
The teacher explains why some dancers use their tiptoes.
The teacher performs the dance in traditional attire.

metaphors: like ballet has first, second, third position
common_mistakes: dancing on tiptoes instead of flat-footed

steps_taught.name: Basic Punta Step
steps_taught.description: A flat-footed step with hip movement.

quotes.text: Punta is danced flat-footed, not on your tippy-toes.
That's how I taught my son.
You don't want to just look flat.
That was actually invented by the Afro-Garifunas.
This is really not the Punta attire.

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher stands on a wooden bridge and speaks directly to the camera.
The teacher demonstrates the forward and backward movement of the feet.
The teacher demonstrates the hip movement from side to side.
The teacher demonstrates the basic step from the back.
The teacher demonstrates arm movements while performing the basic step.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teacher uses the analogy of ballet positions to explain how to incorporate arm movements into the dance.
